Title: StorSimple Virtual Appliance model 1100 now called StorSimple Cloud Appliance 8010

Body.Content: With the release of the StorSimple 8000 Series Update 2, the StorSimple virtual appliance model 1100 has been renamed StorSimple Cloud Appliance 8010. This appliance model will coexist with the StorSimple 8020 cloud appliance, which was released with the update. For more information about the two models, please refer to the detailed announcement: Announcing the StorSimple Cloud Appliance 8020.
Body.Markdown:
With the release of the StorSimple 8000 Series Update 2, the StorSimple virtual appliance model 1100 has been renamed StorSimple Cloud Appliance 8010. This appliance model will coexist with the StorSimple 8020 cloud appliance , which was released with the update.

For more information about the two models, please refer to the detailed announcement: Announcing the StorSimple Cloud Appliance 8020 .
